extraction.experiment: Halving the contact rate α and doubling the removal rate β flatten the SIR peak I(t)/N to the same height, but the reader sees the β route reach its peak and fall below the safety level in about half the time. This is the scaling law of Eq. (23) (II.3, Table 1).
extraction.reproduce: Raising γ twofold by halving α (social distancing) lowers the peak to about 0.30 N, but the peak arrives near day 82 and the safe level near day 189.
extraction.contrast: Raising γ by the same factor through doubling β (early detection and isolation) gives the same peak height, but the peak and the safe level both arrive in roughly half the time.
